//CardMedia: CardMedia.css is the second half of Card.css, split out on 2026-08-26 when that file reached 717 lines carrying two subjects. It reads --card-motion, a token the card declares on itself and the media inherits at runtime; only the linter cannot see across the file boundary. The override names Card.css for this ONE file rather than adding a component's private tokens to the global importFrom, which would let every component's privates resolve everywhere.
